title: Ad break (open-world game parody, free version)
concept: A night in an open-world crime game: the TV in an NPC's apartment plays a LifeFlow ad, the camera goes through the screen into the ad (the NPC's real LifeFlow day with a casino heist on it), then back out. Original world and characters.

scenes.title: Night in the apartment, the ad comes on, through the screen
scenes.why: Stylised 3D room in code. Paid version: a MAGI-2 room plate with a green TV screen, the ad pinned onto it in code.

scenes.title: In the ad: the NPC's real LifeFlow day
scenes.why: The real app (nico-mission capture) on a 3D phone: always code.

scenes.title: The heads-up becomes a mission
scenes.why: HUD graphics are code. Paid version: a MAGI-2 street plate behind them.

scenes.title: Flowers: who are you?
scenes.why: Subtitles over the sky. Paid version: the MAGI-2 rooftop two-shot.

scenes.title: Back in the room: Where do I get that app?
scenes.why: Same room; the sign-off plays on the TV.
